intro: A Grizzled Scalp is the thick, furred hide taken from grizzled thistle bears roaming the southern forests of Darkshore. While seemingly an odd trophy, these pelts are sought by the eccentric gnome tinkerer Wizbang Cranktoggle to supply his hidden wilderness machinery.
